reviewed and approved by geotechnical engineer, safety officer, and project manager; updated if excavation conditions vary significantly from planned Download ExcelDownload PDF **40** Checkpoints **8** Sections Submitted for approval before excavation; reviewed monthly or when site conditions change Contractor, Site Engineer [IS 3764:1992](https://infralens.in/code/IS-3764-1992) [IS 1904:1986](https://infralens.in/code/IS-1904-1986) [IS 2720:2011](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2720-Part-2-1973) Related [📐IS 3764](https://infralens.in/code/IS-3764) [✏️Isolated Footing Depth Thum…](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/isolated-footing-depth-thumb-rule) [📘Soil Classification (IS 149…](https://infralens.in/handbook/soil-classification) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧steel-table](https://infralens.in/tools/steel-table) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. Scope of Excavation | | A1 | Excavation description — Type, location, dimensions clearly stated
Acceptance: Document must specify: excavation for foundation pit / basement / trench / utility crossing; plan area (m²); depth below ground level; volume estimate (m³) | IS 3764 Clause 4 (General requirements) | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A2 | Soil type from investigation report — Classification per IS 2720 Part 2
Acceptance: Soil classification (clay / sand / gravel / rock) taken from geotechnical report; stratum thickness and depth to water table stated; safe slope angle determined per IS 3764 Table 1 | IS 3764 Clause 5.1 (Site investigation data) | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A3 | Purpose of excavation — Foundation / basement / trench / utility stated clearly
Acceptance: Purpose determines depth, slope angle, and support system; e.g., shallow foundation pit vs. deep basement requiring bracing | IS 1904 Clause 2.1 (Classification of foundations) | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B. Reference Documents | | B1 | IS codes referenced — IS 3764, IS 1904, IS 2720, and project specifications
Acceptance: All applicable IS code editions listed; project-specific specifications and approved drawings referenced; site-specific limitations noted (e.g., proximity to existing structures) | Regulatory compliance | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B2 | Geotechnical investigation report — Reference and approval date
Acceptance: Report title, reference number, approval date stated; bearing capacity, settlement analysis, slope stability conclusions extracted | IS 1892 compliance | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B3 | Approved drawings — Structural foundation plan, site layout, excavation limits
Acceptance: Architectural and structural drawings referenced by revision; foundation pit extent, depth, and final levels marked; utility positions shown | Design compliance | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C. Materials and Equipment | | C1 | Excavation equipment — Type, capacity, and specifications stated
Acceptance: Excavator make/model/bucket capacity; dumper capacity; crane capacity (if used); mobile phones for communication; equipment must be certified for onsite use | Safe excavation practice | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C2 | Dewatering equipment — Pump capacity (if needed), sump pit design, monitoring
Acceptance: Pump capacity (m³/hr) sufficient for expected water inflow; sump pit size (min 1.5 m³); wellpoint system or open sump specified; discharge location approved | IS 3764 Clause 8 (Dewatering) | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C3 | Shoring material — Type (steel / timber / diaphragm wall) for slopes >1.5 m depth
Acceptance: For vertical or near-vertical sides >1.5 m: steel sheet piling / soldier piles with lagging / timber props; design calculations provided; props spaced per design | IS 3764 Clause 7 (Support systems) | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C4 | PCC for blinding — Grade (typically M10), thickness ≥75 mm
Acceptance: PCC M10 for blinding; minimum 75 mm thick; placed after final excavation trimming and geotechnical approval; cube samples tested | IS 456 Clause 5 (Materials) | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C5 | Survey instruments — Level, theodolite for setting out and monitoring
Acceptance: Level and theodolite available onsite; survey crew identified; bench marks established; daily level monitoring of excavation base | Accurate excavation control | OK
NC
